study type: qualitative, exploratory, descriptive, documentary, and retrospective review
exposure: Three subcategories of 'Choice for Cesarean Section': who chooses cesarean section; preference for cesarean section defined during prenatal care; and possibility to choose cesarean section during labor
cohort: 169 postpartum women who underwent a cesarean section, from the database extension project Group of Pregnant Women and Pregnant Couples by the Universidade Federal de Santa Catarina (1996-2013).
finding: The choice for cesarean section during prenatal care was influenced by medical authority, and during labor, it was motivated by prolonged duration and pain from contractions.
